extracted.name: Oven SPAM Sandwiches
extracted.description: For a quick and satisfying lunch, opt for these sandwiches made with just a few pantry staples like canned lunch meat (SPAM), mayo, and relish, that require no stovetop cooking, just the heat of the oven to create a hot sandwich melt.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) can fully cooked luncheon meat (such as SPAM®), cubed
0.75 (1 pound) loaf processed cheese food (such as Velveeta®), cubed
0.5 cup creamy salad dressing (such as Miracle Whip®)
instruction_lines: Combine luncheon meat, cheese, salad dressing, and relish in a bowl; mic to combine. Divide evenly amongst hamburger buns. Wrap each sandwich in aluminum foil; place onto a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until the filling is hot and buns are toasted, 10 to 15 minutes.
